title: Outdoor pedestrian plaza with large commercial buildings and many people
objects_and_counts: At least 20 distinct pedestrians are visible across the foreground and midground; several are walking left-to-right while others walk right-to-left. Many are partially occluded by other people or by the frame edges.
One person in the right foreground is wearing a dark coat and a white face mask and is holding a white umbrella in their right hand and a patterned bag in their left hand.
Multiple backpacks and shoulder bags are visible on pedestrians; individual bag types cannot be exhaustively counted because some are obscured.
A continuous metal pedestrian railing runs along the left side of the image at the edge of the plaza; the railing is visible from foreground to midground.
A row of at least six identical streetlight posts with curved double-arm lamp heads lines the plaza adjacent to the long building on the right (some lamp posts are partially cropped).
At least five large trimmed round shrubs/trees are planted in a line between the building and the pedestrian walkway; some are partially obscured by people.
Tiled paving covers the entire visible walking surface; tiles form a repeating square pattern.
Two large commercial buildings are visible: a multi-storey glass-and-white-clad building on the left and a long brown/tan building with many horizontal windows on the right.
spatial_relations: A wide tiled pedestrian walkway occupies the foreground and center of the image; pedestrians traverse it in both directions.

On the image right, a long brown/tan building with horizontal window bands runs diagonally from foreground right toward the background center-right; the row of streetlight posts and trimmed shrubs sit between that building and the walkway.

On the image left, a white and glass multi-storey building (marked with the visible word 'PARCO') sits behind a low concrete balustrade and railing that runs along the left edge of the walkway; the railing separates the walkway from a lower plaza area or water feature not fully visible.
People cluster more densely toward the midground center where an entrance or corridor into the long building appears to be located; fewer pedestrians are at the extreme left edge near the railing.
Several pedestrians walking near the center partially occlude the trimmed shrubs and the bases of the lamp posts; some lamp posts are visible in front of the building windows.
colours_and_materials: The long building on the right has a brown/tan textured facade with dark horizontal window frames and reflective glass windows.
The building on the left is largely white and glass-clad with light-blue reflective glazing.
The pedestrian paving is composed of square tiles in varying tones of grey and muted pink.
The metal pedestrian railing along the left edge appears to be painted or finished in a light beige or off-white.
Shrubs between the walkway and the building are dark green and appear to be trimmed into rounded forms.
uncertainties: The exact count of pedestrians cannot be determined precisely because many are partially occluded or cropped at the frame edges; 'at least 20' is a conservative visible minimum.
Small printed text on banners, posters and on the far building rooftop signage is not legible in the image; only the large 'PARCO' sign is clearly readable.

Any interior room names, room numbers, or facility identifiers are not visible; therefore the specific location (for example, a named wing or room such as 'Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing') cannot be confirmed from the image.
Some streetlight posts and shrubs are partially cropped at top or sides of the frame, so the precise total of those items is uncertain.
No equipment nameplates, control panels or laboratory fixtures are visible; the scene appears to be an outdoor public plaza rather than an interior lab or workshop space.
